dayRecord.title: Day Record
dayRecord.description: Daily study tracker record containing all logged activities, status, completion %, notes, and timestamps for a specific date.

date.description: Date of the record in YYYY-MM-DD format

userId.description: Firebase UID of the user owning this record

completedActivities.description: Count of activities marked as Done

partialActivities.description: Count of activities marked as Partial

skippedActivities.description: Count of activities marked as Skipped

totalMinutesSpent.description: Total actual study minutes logged for the day

activities.description: Array of activity records with status, time spent, and notes

categoryProgress.description: Progress breakdown by category (jobPrep, dsa, english, gate, morning, advanced)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the day record was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the day record was last updated

userProfile.title: User Profile & Settings
userProfile.description: Stores user settings, preferences, 30-day challenge config, and timetable custom overrides.

challengeStartDate.description: Starting date for current 30-day consistency challenge

customTimetable.description: Custom subject rotations or modified activity schedules

/users/{userId}/days/{dateId}.description: Daily study tracking records for each user by date

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: User settings, challenge start date, and preferences
